_note: CS-003 Our New Home: Amelia and Oliver, once the house has been looked around and Coco and Charlie have been met. Same shape as box_talk.json (BoxTalk plays it). Lines are drafts and placeholders until the real words are added. It ends by sending Amelia into town (Mission 2).

lines.text: There you are. That's the last of the boxes in from the car.
I've been round every room. It needs some work, but it already feels like ours.
Coco has claimed the window already, and Charlie has found the warmest spot in the house.
I'll make a start on the kitchen. Why don't you go and meet the neighbours? Someone should know we've arrived.
All right. I'll walk into town and say hello.
